inputs.name: assessCleanCode.result
inputs.description: The JEV evaluation whose answers map must hold a JevChoice for every rubric principle id, because assessCleanCode reads answers[principle.id] for each one. Only answers is read, so model and usage do not change the output, and a missing entry makes the call throw a TypeError.

inputs.name: assessCleanCode.minConfidence
inputs.description: The confidence threshold that an answer's confidence must reach for its choice to be kept; a confidence below it, or an insufficient_context choice, makes the status needs-review. assessCleanCode compares it directly with >= without validating it, while harness.audit.json cleanCode.minConfidence accepts only finite values above 0 and at most 1, defaulting to 0.85.

inputs.name: fileReviewStatus.assessments
inputs.description: The principle assessments whose statuses roll up into one file status. fileReviewStatus reads only each item's status: any status 'violates' gives violations, otherwise any 'needs-review' gives needs-review, and 'meets', 'not-applicable' or an empty array give clean.

outputs.name: assessCleanCode
outputs.description: One assessment per rubric principle, in rubric order, made from that principle's JEV answer (type, choice, confidence and probabilities) plus its principle id, title and guidance. outputs.name: fileReviewStatus
outputs.description: The file-level status: violations when any assessment status is 'violates', otherwise needs-review when any is 'needs-review', otherwise clean. It never returns incomplete or not-applicable, and an empty assessments array gives clean.

outputs.name: reportReviewStatus
outputs.description: The report-level status: not-applicable for an empty files array, otherwise incomplete if any file is incomplete, then violations, then needs-review, and clean when no file is incomplete, has violations, or needs review. A single incomplete file therefore makes the whole report incomplete, even when other files violate.

errors.description: Thrown by assessCleanCode when result, result.answers, or the entry for a rubric principle id is null or undefined, because the code then reads a property from it. Nothing in this unit catches it, so the TypeError reaches the caller unchanged.
